text: Nia picked up her new puppy on Saturday, a cocker spaniel called Biscuit. She's already exhausted from the night wakings.
Siobhan is vegan now, as of last month. Don't do the lamb when she comes for dinner on the 14th of November.
Chen's birthday is 3rd of December. He's really into bouldering at the moment and mentioned wanting a new chalk bag.
Aoife's cat Pickle has been off his food all week. Vet appointment is Thursday at 4pm and she's quite worried about him.
Kofi doesn't drink at all, so get some decent alcohol-free beer in before Friday.
Bought the cake candles and the wrapping paper. Still need cellotape and a card.

Dana said her daughter Ilse turns seven on 22 November and wants a party at the soft play. Dana is dreading organising it, honestly. I should offer to help with the party bags. Ilse is mad about dinosaurs at the moment, so maybe a dinosaur theme, and Dana mentioned one of the other kids is coeliac, so the cake needs to be gluten free. Party is 2pm till 4pm.
Farid is allergic to tree nuts, properly allergic, carries an EpiPen. Worth remembering for any baking.
Carmen and her husband are celebrating their tenth anniversary on 5/12 with a weekend in Edinburgh. Her mum is having the kids.
Salma mentioned she's been getting really into loose leaf tea. Oolong especially. Could be a good Christmas present.
Remind me to text Alina on Monday morning to ask how the puppy's first vet visit went.
Haruto's dog Mochi turned ten yesterday. He made her a little cake out of liver and sweet potato, which is adorable.
Bilal's barbecue on Sunday is cancelled because of the forecast. He might do something indoors the weekend after instead.
Svetlana is off gluten after her coeliac diagnosis in September. She's finding it hard, especially eating out. Need to check the menu at the Italian before we book.
Hiroshi Tanaka, Hiro to everyone at work, is retiring on 19 December. There's a collection going round and I want to put in twenty quid.
Lorenzo only drinks Negronis. Whatever the occasion, that's his drink.

Victor said his partner Oscar has a big audition on the 28th at 2pm for a touring musical. Oscar is apparently a bag of nerves. Must send him a good luck message that morning. Victor says Oscar hasn't eaten properly in days and is living on peppermint tea and toast. If he gets it, the tour starts in February and runs until June, which would mean months apart for them.
Shira's rabbit died over the weekend. She'd had him for nine years. Drop round with some flowers on Wednesday evening.
Lunch with Arturo was lovely. He's moved to Leith and loves it, says the cafes are brilliant. He's thinking about getting a whippet.

Samir's mum has her hip operation on 2nd November. He's going to stay with her for the week afterwards. I should call him on the Friday to see how she's doing. He's worried about the stairs at her place and whether she'll manage on her own. Their dog Sasha is going to the neighbour while he's away. He also said he's barely sleeping, so maybe offer to walk Sasha one evening.
Connor is doing Dry January again, starting on New Year's Day. Plan the get-together for February instead.
Javier hates coriander with a passion. Says it tastes like soap.
Hoang and her boyfriend are getting a kitten from the rescue centre next Saturday morning. They've already named it Pho.
Claire's son starts at the new nursery on 4 November and she's nervous about leaving him. Don't forget to message her that afternoon to see how drop-off went.
Sunil loves anything spicy. The hotter the better. He grows his own chillies on the balcony, including a few Carolina Reapers.

Marisol's fortieth is on the 17th of January. Her sister Farah is organising a surprise dinner at Dishoom, the 18th at half 7. Farah asked everyone to chip in for a spa voucher, which Marisol has been hinting at for months. She's not to know anything. Farah also wants a playlist of songs from when they were teenagers, so she's asking everyone for suggestions by the 10th. Marisol is pescatarian, which narrows the menu a bit.
Need to book the car in for its MOT before the end of the month.
Imani's birthday was on Tuesday and I completely forgot. Send her a belated card and maybe some of those salted caramel brownies she likes.
Nia says Biscuit has already chewed through two phone chargers. She's signed him up for puppy classes starting 1st of November at 10am.
Olivia mentioned she's lactose intolerant but fine with oat milk. Remember for coffee.

Kofi told me his brother Samir got engaged last weekend in Accra. The wedding will probably be next summer, back in Ghana, and Kofi is going to be best man. He's already panicking about the speech. Their mum is thrilled and has started planning the menu, jollof for three hundred people apparently. I should send Kofi a congratulations card for the family.
Caught up with Chen. His girlfriend has been unwell for weeks and they still don't have a diagnosis. He sounded tired. Check in with him next week.
Aoife's update on Pickle: it was a urinary infection, antibiotics are working and he's eating again. Big relief all round.

Dana's dad turns eighty on 30 November. The whole family is going to a hotel in the Lakes for the weekend. She asked whether I knew any good whisky, as he collects single malts. He's into Islay ones, peaty and smoky, and he's already got Laphroaig and Ardbeg. Dana's thinking of getting him a tasting experience instead of another bottle. They leave on the Friday at about 4pm and come back Sunday evening.
Farid is doing Ramadan this year, so no lunch plans with him until it's over.
Picked up the dog food and the flea treatment. Grooming appointment for Rolo is Saturday at 9.
Carmen said Oscar's partner Victor is training for the Manchester marathon in April. He's vegetarian and eating huge amounts of pasta.
Ilse would love anything to do with unicorns, according to Dana. Also she's just started ballet.

Salma's cat Noor needs a dental op on the 9th of December, first thing in the morning. Salma is fretting about the anaesthetic because Noor is fourteen. I should text her that evening to see how it went, and maybe take round some of her favourite chai.
Haruto and his wife are expecting their first baby in March. He's over the moon and already reading every parenting book going.
Bilal drinks his coffee black, no sugar, and refuses to go anywhere that doesn't do a flat white for his wife.
Svetlana's son Connor has his driving test on Friday at 11:15. Third attempt, so she's a bit anxious for him.
Booked myself a pottery class on 23 November at 2pm. Treat for finishing the project.
Hiro mentioned his granddaughter has just started at Leeds studying vet medicine. He's incredibly proud.
Lorenzo's dog Bruno went missing on Sunday afternoon but turned up at a neighbour's at about 8pm. Lorenzo is still shaken.
Victor's birthday is 11/02. Big fan of jazz, collects vinyl. A Blue Note reissue would go down well.

Shira mentioned she's been struggling since losing the rabbit, more than she expected. She's not sleeping well and work is busy. Maybe invite her round for dinner next weekend, something low key. She doesn't eat pork, keeps kosher-ish at home, so maybe the fish curry.
Arturo and his partner are hosting a housewarming on the 6th at 7pm. I'm bringing a bottle of red and the cheese board.
Samir told me he's thinking of going part-time to help look after his mum once she's out of hospital.
Connor's girlfriend Aoife Kim is a pastry chef, so absolutely no shop-bought desserts at the dinner on Saturday.

Javier's first day at the new job is Monday at 8am. He's going from finance to running a bakery with his cousin. Ask him on Monday evening how it went. He's been baking sourdough at home for years, so it's sort of a dream come true, but he's nervous about the 4am starts. His cousin Marisol handles the money side. Grand opening is Saturday the 14th at 10am and I'd like to go.
Hoang says the kitten is settling in well, though it hides under the sofa most of the day. Apparently she's allergic to cats herself and is taking antihistamines every morning.
Claire is doing keto. No bread, no potatoes, lots of eggs. She says she's never felt better.
Sunil's sister Imani graduates on the 15th of July in Birmingham. He's driving up the night before with their parents.
Marisol says she loves Earl Grey, hates anything with mint, and is trying to cut down on sugar.
Note to self: return the library books by Thursday and pick up the prescription.

Imani's little boy has a dairy allergy and an egg allergy. When they come over on Sunday 26th at lunchtime, check every label. I'll make the birthday cake vegan. It's for her husband's birthday, which is actually the Monday after, but they're celebrating early. He's into cycling and craft beer, especially sours. Imani said a new bike light would be useful because his got nicked last week.
Uncle Chen's seventieth is on 8 March. Aunty wants a family photo book as the main present, and she asked me to dig out old pictures from the 90s.

Dr Reyes, Olivia's vet, said the puppy needs her second jab on 12/11 at half 9 and shouldn't go on walks until a week after. Olivia is going stir crazy already. The puppy is a golden retriever called Honey, and she's eaten one shoe, a TV remote and half a cushion so far. Olivia's boyfriend Lorenzo is the one doing the night shifts. Remind me to send her that puppy training book on Friday.
Farah's dog Coco turned one last Wednesday. They threw her a party in the park with a doggy cake. Farah sent about forty photos.
